description: An elderly man with white hair and a black ribbon queue, in a dark coat with white cuffs, raises one arm and holds a rolled sheet of paper aloft. He faces a large candlelit hall with gilt ceiling paintings and crystal chandeliers, where an orchestra of strings, horns and a harpsichord plays and a chorus of men and women in 18th-century dress sings from music stands. A shaft of light falls through a high window onto the scene.
